in_marathi.name: Anshula
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ansh (meaning) + UlA (goddess of light)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anshula हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anshula is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Ansh' (meaning) and 'UlA' (goddess of light). This name signifies one who illuminates knowledge and wisdom. In Hindu mythology, Anshula is associated with the goddess Saraswati, who is the embodiment of knowledge, music, and arts. The name holds a spiritual significance and is believed to bring wisdom, knowledge, and enlightenment.
